title: Coherence Sweeps
summary: This module performs alpha sweeps to determine optimal scaling factors for persona traits based on a coherence floor, outputting recommended scales for sycophancy and chaos traits.

nodes.label: Run Coherence Alpha Sweep
nodes.title: Main Entrypoint for Coherence Alpha Sweep
nodes.description: Initializes logging, parses command-line arguments, and orchestrates the coherence alpha sweep for specified persona traits (sycophancy, chaos, or both).

nodes.label: Load Trait Bundles and Vectors
nodes.title: Load Persona Trait Data
nodes.description: Loads persona trait bundles (JSON) and corresponding persona vectors (PyTorch tensors) from specified file paths for sycophancy and chaos traits.

nodes.label: Execute Alpha Sweep Logic
nodes.title: Perform Coherence Alpha Sweep
nodes.description: Executes the core logic for the coherence alpha sweep, iterating through alpha values to find the optimal scaling factor that meets the coherence floor.

nodes.label: Output Results to JSON
nodes.title: Save and Display Sweep Results
nodes.description: Formats the sweep results, including recommended scaling factors, into a JSON document and writes it to a specified output file, also printing to console.

nodes.label: Persona Evaluation and Testing
nodes.title: Persona Evaluation and Testing
nodes.description: This module provides tools and scripts for validating, evaluating, and testing persona steering mechanisms and their effects on model behavior.

groups.label: Sweep Orchestration
groups.title: Coherence Sweep Orchestration
groups.description: Handles the overall flow of the coherence alpha sweep, from argument parsing to result output.

groups.label: Core Sweep Logic
groups.title: Core Alpha Sweep Computation
groups.description: Encapsulates the iterative process of adjusting alpha values and evaluating coherence to find optimal scaling factors.
